Package frc.robot.aiming

Interface AimStrategy

All Known Implementing Classes:
PhysicsAim, ToFAim, TuneAim
public interface AimStrategy
Strategy interface for calculating shot parameters from the current robot state.

Implementations represent distinct aiming modes (e.g., physics-based ballistic calculation via PhysicsAim, calibration-table lookup via ToFAim, manual SmartDashboard tuning via TuneAim). The active strategy is selected in RobotStateMachine and swapped at runtime without changing the calling code.

All implementations must return an AimParams with a Possible status when a valid solution exists, or Impossible when the geometry cannot be solved (e.g., target behind the robot, out of hood range).

  • Method Details

    • update

      AimParams update(edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Pose3d target, edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Pose3d shooter, edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Translation2d velocity)
      Computes the shot parameters needed to hit target from shooter.
      Parameters:
      target - The 3D pose of the scoring target (hub center) in field coordinates.
      shooter - The 3D pose of the shooter mechanism in field coordinates.
      velocity - The robot's current field-relative velocity (x, y in m/s), used for lead compensation when the robot is moving.
      Returns:
      The computed AimParams, with status Possible on success or Impossible if no valid shot exists.
